findings.message: The `prefs` cookie is fully controlled by the client, and `pickle.loads` on it lets anyone run arbitrary code on the server by sending a crafted pickle payload. Never unpickle untrusted input.

When the cookie is absent, the default `""` decodes to `b""` and `pickle.loads(b"")` raises `EOFError`. Malformed base64 or a non-dict value also raises instead of falling back to `light`, so ordinary first-time visitors get a 500 error.
The new `preferences` handler changes behaviour but the change adds no test for it, including the missing-cookie and malformed-cookie cases.
